functional_exclusions: Load-cell bearing pads and bolt seats
Rail slopes within the 100 mm spool width
Guide sliding feet and inner spool-facing planes
Central NFC antenna face and 1.2 mm window
PCB support pads and OLED glass seat
Indicator opening throats; only front edges are beveled
edge_finishing.coordinate_note: Selections are recorded in each construction frame before later mirror/rotation; repeated adjustment cases reuse the same predicates.

fastener_references.included: Eight nominal M3 cover/rail/guide clamp sets, four stop screws and NFC mounting hardware
fastener_references.not_complete: Load-cell screws, threads, screw drives, cable ties and adhesive are not modeled

boot_access.opening: Dedicated angled BOOT bore in the closed USB wall; relocated board estimate
boot_access.button_position_evidence: Photo estimate only; verify actual board, cable and button before printing

nfc_mounts.hardware: Three nylon M3 x 12, three 0.5 mm washers and three M3 captive nuts on the moving pod; the fourth identical set retains the cable cover.
nfc_mounts.board_retention: Four edge seats, 0.3 mm edge clearance and three cover fingers with 0.3 mm foam allowance. No board screws; verify delivered component-free margins.
nfc_mounts.retention: Rigid upper tongue and lower M3 clamp; nut side-entry pocket retains axial pullout. Clearance/removal sampling is geometric evidence, not strength, fatigue or foam-pressure validation.
nfc_mounts.print_note: Print pod cover positive-Y side edge down (-90 degrees about X); use a brim and local support beneath PCB fingers and cable hood. This is not a support-free print.

lid_service.motion: Remove two front screws; slide lid forward 1.4 mm, then lift vertically clear of the narrowed cradle.
lid_service.method: Conservative full-motion ring and hook slab envelopes; electronics remain installed.

structural_joints.rail_service_precondition: Spool and both guide assemblies removed; rail screw removed.
structural_joints.stop_gap_note: Geometric adjustment range only. Actual safe load-cell travel and stop setting must be measured.

indicator_fit.oled_fit: Provisional generic envelope; actual PCB, glass, pins and controller not identified. Winstar WEA012864D-03 gives 27.3 mm square, Joy-IT SBC-OLED01 gives 27 mm square; neither identifies the user board. No board hole pitch assumed.
indicator_fit.led_fit: 60 LEDs/m confirmed; 10 mm strip width and 5050 package provisional. Five-pixel cut length, coating and pads require measurement.
indicator_fit.attachment: Supports integrated into fixed base front wall; service through main lid. No separate fascia or rear cover.
indicator_fit.oled_retention: Open-top PCB side guides, lower front edge pad, bottom stop and rear edge rails with 0.4 mm nominal foam allowance. No PCB hole pattern assumed; do not clamp glass.
indicator_fit.wiring: Front controls wire inside the fixed base. Keep clear of load-cell leads and moving carrier.
indicator_fit.print_note: Base floor down. Inspect support needs beneath internal LED gutter and PCB edge pads; all are accessible through the main lid. Fit coupons include the actual retained support geometry.

cover_retention.limits: 18 sampled cover poses per translation leg, 17 sampled nut insertion poses and one pullout obstruction check. These are clearance evidence, not retention-force or print-tolerance validation.

nfc_cable_route.tail_continuous_bounds_method: The cubic Bezier lies inside its control-point convex hull; control x spans the full width interval, and the 2 mm bundle radius expands that hull. The R5 semicircle and straight ends have fixed bounds. The checked boxes enclose those bounds.
nfc_cable_route.tail_model: Nominal routing and a conservative free-space envelope; no constant-length flex simulation or cable spring-force measurement. Dress slack within this space and re-zero/check at every adjustment.
nfc_cable_route.maintenance: One nylon M3 x 12, one 0.5 mm washer and one captive M3 nut. Remove screw, translate cover 3.5 mm in +Y then pull outward to release rigid tongue. One cover exposes rear cassette and lower side gutter.
nfc_cable_route.concealment: Upper route behind guide/pod and removable cover; lower chute overlaps the open carrier bay without touching fixed lid. The flexible tail remains below the lid inside the base.

power_fit.converter_placement: User chooses and verifies wall attachment; no reserved module volume

comparison_to_v0_2.meaning: Analytic CAD solid volume, including print quantities; not mass or sliced filament.
